settings.headline: Disclosures and important notices
settings.subtitle: Kestrel Valley Credit Union is fictional. This page shows where a real credit union would put its required notices.

settings.headline: This is a demo site
settings.body:
Kestrel Valley Credit Union does not exist. It is a fictional credit union made to show what a credit union or community bank website built with the open-source Raytha CMS can look like. No one can open an account or apply for a loan here, and no deposits are insured.

On a real credit union website

  • The federal share insurance statement and logo would appear here and in the footer.
  • The Equal Housing Opportunity (or Equal Housing Lender) notice would appear on home loan pages.
  • Truth in Savings and Truth in Lending disclosures would be linked from every rate table.
  • The privacy notice and fee schedule would be linked from the footer, as they are on the documents page.

Rates shown on this site are invented and are not offers of credit.
settings.side: The fictional fee schedule and privacy notice are on the documents page.
